subject: AlphaHealth discovery — milestones & MPA checklist
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Ellis <sarah.ellis@alphahealth.com>, Tom Kline <tom.k@alphahealth.com>
Cc: procurement <ops@alphahealth.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 14:12:00 -0800
Subject: AlphaHealth discovery — quick recap & proposed milestones

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for carving out 45 minutes today. Wanted to capture what we heard and propose a short mutual action plan so we stay aligned. High-level summary below, followed by suggested next steps and owners.

What we heard (pain & goals)
- Pain: Slow clinical note ingestion and inconsistent entity extraction causing delayed coding and billing downstream.
- Goal: Reduce time-to-first-draft by ~60% for triage notes and increase entity extraction F1 from current ~0.72 to >=0.88 for ICD mapping.
- Constraints: PHI-sensitive data; on-prem or VPC deployment with customer-managed KMS.

Proposed MPA (milestones & owners)
1) Security & compliance review (AlphaHealth -> provide SOC2 doc, Redwood -> provide network diagram + data flow) — target 11/30 — Owner: Sarah (Alpha) / Naomi (Redwood)
2) Pilot scope & test set delivery (Alpha -> sample de-identified dataset, Redwood -> pilot model+config) — target 12/07 — Owner: Tom (Alpha) / Naomi (Redwood)
3) Pilot run & evaluation (2-week pilot) — target 12/08–12/21 — Owner: Alpha clinical team / Redwood success lead
4) Procurement & contracting (PO/negotiation) — target sign by 12/28 — Owner: Alpha procurement / Marissa (Redwood)

Immediate asks from us
- Sarah/Tom: share the Risk & Security questionnaire and a sample of de-id triage notes by 11/26. You can use ops@alphahealth if that helps.
- Redwood: we will send a small MPA template and a short pilot checklist by EOD 11/22.

Attachments: inaugural Risk questionnaire attached for your convenience.

If this looks right I’ll circulate a one-page MPA and lock in the dates. Happy to shift timelines to fit your procurement window.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198
[Attachment: Alpha_Risk_Questionnaire.pdf (pdf)]

Thanks Naomi — this is very helpful and captures the call. A few notes: 
- We can provide a de-identified sample by 11/25; our security lead will need the SOC2 and network diagram to sign off but that timeline looks feasible.
- Procurement (ops@alphahealth) prefers to review any standard SOW/MPA before committing to dates — I’m looping them in here (they were on the original call).

I’ll also introduce our clinical lead (brief intro) if helpful for the pilot scoping.

Sarah — perfect, thanks for the fast reply and the clarification. Short answers and next steps from Redwood’s side: 

VPC deployment: yes — we support a VPC/private deployment with per-customer isolation and no shared prefix caching; we’ll provide the network diagram and KMS integration notes.

Marissa (cc) — can you confirm the procurement/PO cadence and whether standard Redwood MPA + SOW will suffice for a pilot at AlphaHealth? If you prefer, I can send a draft MPA and a simple SOW calling out pilot scope, deliverables, and evaluation metrics.

Next actions:
- Naomi to share the Redwood MPA template + pilot checklist by EOD 11/23.
- Alpha to share de-id sample and questionnaire answers by 11/25.
- Marissa to advise on contracting cadence/any required redlines.

Hi all — looping in quick procurement guidance.

Summary of commercial path:
- Pilot MPA + SOW (no upfront committed spend) — typical term 2–4 weeks; Redwood sets demo/pilot pricing based on pilot scope.
- If pilot demonstrates expected deltas, we move to a reserved capacity quote (monthly commit) or a hosted usage agreement depending on AlphaHealth’s preference.

Procurement asks from AlphaHealth (please):
1) Confirm PO workflow (who signs, billing contact).
2) Any required security addendum or specific clauses (we can accommodate most enterprise requests; will need time for legal review).
3) Desired target date to complete pilot (we recommend starting pilot within 2 weeks of MPA sign).

Next steps — commercial owner actions:
- Naomi: send the MPA + simple SOW (done) and include a short pilot pricing note.
- Alpha procurement: confirm billing contact and PO cadence; if there are standard vendor forms upload them to the DocuSign link and I’ll review with legal.

Marissa Cole
